channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Killington Resort will host the women's World Cup giant slalom and slalom races over Thanksgiving weekend. Snowmaking crews prepared the course despite early weather challenges. The event includes live music and community activities alongside the races.

Vermont's eighty million dollar IT modernization project has been paused since April. A recent audit called the progress "unsatisfactory" and raised concerns about cost and timeline. Officials plan six more months to prepare before restarting the project.

Neighbors Together in Ludlow has partnered with Assisting Children Today. ACT has committed twelve thousand dollars to help expand services. This partnership aims to support more individuals and families in the community.

Peter Greene, seventy-eight, of Pawlet was found dead in Mt. Tabor after a hunting trip. Vermont State Police searched with dogs and drones starting Saturday evening. Authorities say the death is not suspicious.
